title: Fix stdlib classify.spec.tac mocks for Model-based LLMClassifier
description: CI pytest was running stdlib BDD specs (tactus/stdlib/tac/tactus/classify.spec.tac) and LLM scenarios attempted real OpenAI calls because mocks were defined as Agent mocks. Update the spec to mock the Model name (stdlib_classify_llm) via conditional model mocks, import NaiveBayesClassifier properly, and make NaiveBayesClassifier resilient to Python dict-like outputs. Also apply Mocks {..} directly to MockManager at parse time so custom step sandboxes see mocks.
creator: Ryan Alyn Porter

custom.beads_close_reason: Updated classify.spec.tac to use Model mocks + fixed NaiveBayesClassifier import/interop; applied mocks to MockManager during parse for custom steps.
